findings.reason: The approved feature stores bounded server-derived context keyed to an exact completed turn, not a full-answer transcript. The vote remains attached to the correct durable turn and all text is server-derived/deidentified. Independent full acceptance audit found no violated requirement. Concatenating all earlier messages would change deliberate context selection; no such expansion is required by this review.
